title: ReportResult
description: Response body for POST /api/reports. Always an aggregated summary — never an array of transactions. The underlying transactions are not returned; a consumer that needs them calls /api/transactions with a date filter separately.

period.description: Short string descriptor of the resolved coverage. 'yyyy-Www' for IsoWeek (e.g., '2026-W20'); 'yyyy-MM-dd..yyyy-MM-dd' for Period. Future report types document their own format.

incomeTotal.description: Sum of Income-direction transaction amounts in the period.

expenseTotal.description: Sum of Expense-direction transaction amounts in the period.

categoryBreakdown.description: Ordered income-side (positive total) first, then expense-side (negative total); by category name ascending within each group. May be empty when the period contains no transactions.

total.description: Signed: positive for income-side contribution, negative for expense-side. The sign is the direction indicator.
